important_notes: Never conflate unverified synonym with accepted species
Required for site-to-site effects and mating connectivity
Phenology and year are measured not assumed
Morphological dioecy not equal functional sex performance
Avoid clonal ramets as independent genets
Visits per effort are not pollen delivery probabilities
Use consistent contrasts; identify resource limitation and inbreeding depression
Different genetic specimens must not be paired without voucher evidence
Separate literature reported from directly observed values
